summary: Creates random values as new attributes or sets, adds, or multiplies existing attributes per point, vertex, or primitive. It supports uniform, discrete, two-value, direction, sphere, Gaussian, exponential, log-normal, Cauchy-Lorentz, and custom-ramp distributions.

key_params.name: extrapts
key_params.note: Additional random points generated per source point

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: Custom ramp source when using the custom ramp distribution

key_params.name: parsize
key_params.note: Number of independently configured parameter lanes

key_params.name: valuea
key_params.note: First value for distributions that use two values or ranges

key_params.name: valueb
key_params.note: Second value for distributions that use two values or ranges

key_params.name: clamp
key_params.note: Clamp generated values between min and max

key_params.name: combineop
key_params.note: Combine generated values with an input attribute

key_params.name: combineattrscope
key_params.note: Input attribute scope used for combine operations

key_params.name: attrtype
key_params.note: Output data type when overriding automatic typing

key_params.name: attrdefaultval
key_params.note: Default output value if random generation cannot be computed

key_params.name: attrclass
key_params.note: Attribute class to operate on when filtering an input

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Optional group limiting which elements are affected

key_params.name: map0op
key_params.note: Source operator for the first mapping block

key_params.name: map0element
key_params.note: Source element for the first mapping block

key_params.name: map0parm
key_params.note: Target parameter for the first mapping block

key_concepts: Random POP creates random attributes or extra points using distributions such as uniform, two-value, direction, sphere, Gaussian, exponential, log-normal, Cauchy-Lorentz, or custom-ramp.
Random Size, Parameter Size, amplitude, exponent, offset, clamp, value, and cone controls define the distribution shape and component layout.
Combine, group, attribute-class, output-attribute, and Map page controls let random values modify existing attributes or vary parameters per point.
common_gotchas: Random POP can increase point density with Extra Points per Source Point; downstream max-count assumptions must account for it.
Direction random values are normalized direction vectors, not arbitrary float3 positions.
Per-point mapping attributes on the Map page can override parameters, so inspect mapped attributes when output is unexpectedly varied.
